meta.name: deliverable-completion
meta.description: Clarifies that file creation tasks are complete when the deliverable is successfully written—no submission step required

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 明确文件创建任务在成功写入后即完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要澄清文件创建任务的完成标准
copy.tagline_en: Clarify that file creation tasks are complete upon successful write
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify completion criteria for file creation tasks

howto.what: 当要求创建文件（如文档、代码、数据导出等）时，Claude会在成功写入文件后直接报告完成，不再搜索或使用“提交/最终化”等工具。
howto.when: 当Claude被要求创建任何文件形式的交付物（例如文档、代码、配置文件等）时触发。尤其适用于可能误以为需要额外提交步骤的场景。

say.note: Claude会创建文件并声明完成。

say.text: 帮我生成一个CSV格式的数据导出。
say.note: Claude会直接生成并确认，无需提交。
Claude会创建文件并结束任务。

howto.what_en: When asked to create file-based deliverables (documents, code, data exports, etc.), Claude will report completion immediately after writing the file successfully, without searching for submission or finalization tools.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude is tasked with creating any file-based deliverable (e.g., documents, code, config files). Especially useful when Claude might otherwise try to add a submission step.

say_en.note: Claude creates file and declares complete.
Claude directly generates and confirms, no submission needed.
Claude creates file and ends task.
